MineMenu 3.3.0 for **Minecraft Java 1.21.1** (Fabric): 16 new hacks, waypoints, time & weather control and a structure finder.

**Player**: **Noclip** (spectator mode, back to your game mode when off), **Zoom** (hold Z, scroll to zoom 1.5× to 50×), **Step-Up**, **Fast Swim**, **Elytra Boost**, **Auto-Eat**, **Auto-Tool**, and **Waypoints...**: 5 named waypoints per world with an arrow and distance in your HUD. Your old Home moves into them by itself; Set Home / Go Home still work.

**Combat**: **Auto-Totem**, **Tame Anything** (right-click any mob with an empty hand: it follows you, never attacks you, and attacks what you hit), **Always Crit**.

**World**: **Chest ESP**, **Growth Aura**, **Fast Breed**, **Time & Weather...** (exact time, day speed from stopped to 60×, sun/rain/thunder) and **Find Structure...** (19 structures, the nearest one shows in your HUD).

**Items**: **Infinite Durability**, **Auto-Fish**, **Instant Build**.

Enable All now skips Noclip (spectator mode would make the other hacks useless). Everything still only works in your own singleplayer world.

## Install

1. Install the [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) for Minecraft **1.21.1**.
2. Put [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) (1.21.1) and **`minemenu-3.3.0.jar`** (below) in your `.minecraft/mods` folder, replacing the old MineMenu jar.
